decisions.reason: The minimum quantity lubrication line sits close to the firm's coolant and fluid-handling know-how for machine-tool users, and in-house R&D lets it interpret results and refine the several models, so keeping it is likely.

The hydrocyclone coolant filter builds directly on the firm's established filtration platforms and engineering knowledge, which gives it strong absorptive capacity to learn from market feedback and improve the product.

The gravity band coolant filter is a core-adjacent modular filtration product that fits the firm's existing know-how, manufacturing and service base, so the firm is well placed to assimilate experience with it and keep it.
